name: J Sports Academy
description_short: A sports day camp run by the Shames JCC on the athletic fields and courts of The Masters School in Dobbs Ferry, for kids entering grades 1 to 9. Campers build skills and technique with coaches in a low pressure setting and eat a hot lunch in the school dining hall.
notes: Two week minimum; weeks need not be consecutive. Non member weekly rate runs from $1,036 a week for 2 weeks down to $857 a week for all 7 ($5,998). JCC member rate: $964 a week for 2 weeks down to $785 a week for 7 ($5,498). Hours 9 to 4. Extended day to 5:30 at the Shames JCC is $100 a week; central buses from Tarrytown and Scarsdale are $50 a week.
